title: इंग्रजी ५: U ते Z
audio: Line audio ids: <template_id>.<line> and <template_id>.<item id>.<line>; shared lines keep their prompt-library id. Generated by tools/gen_voice.py --lesson into content/audio/<tutor>/.

rules.teach_response: right -> random ok_*; 1st wrong -> again_* + teach_<letter>, listen again; 2nd wrong -> moveon_* (no praise), next item; silence -> nohear and listen once more, a second silence moves on (teach turns never hold the child back or change mastery)
rules.quiz_silence: silence -> nohear and listen again; a second silence counts as a wrong attempt
rules.quiz_attempts: 1st wrong -> wrong_* + hint_<letter> (after a double silence: hint only); 2nd wrong -> teach_<letter> as the reveal, child repeats, item goes to the retry round
rules.retry_round: items missed in the quiz are asked once more after retry_intro; still wrong -> left unmastered for the next session
rules.mastered_when: correct in the quiz or retry round

lines.intro: नमस्कार! आज आपण इंग्रजीची सहा अक्षरं शिकूया. चल, सुरू करूया!
lines.quiz_intro: आता एक खेळ! अक्षर बघ आणि त्याचं नाव सांग.
lines.outro: आजचा अभ्यास संपला! आज आपण यू, व्ही, डबल्यू, एक्स, वाय, झेड शिकलो. उद्या भेटूया!
